snippet.title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales – Launch Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is coming June 18, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2. Try the debut demo today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-adventures-of-elliot-the-millennium-tales-debut-demo-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01 

A brand-new action RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT combines exciting action-adventure gameplay with stunning HD-2D for the first time! Join Elliot the adventurer and the fairy Faie in a journey through four ages.

#TheAdventuresofElliot #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
